decision: Approved first-slice source for original four-control and composed/full capture verification; broad A191 classification remains open.

source.manual_scope: complete semantic diff and four changed methods/full Http2Origin501-803; listed owner/caller supporting ranges partial, not fresh whole-file credit

contracts: Unexpected ordinary handler exception records the original TCP record and bare-raises the same object. Existing accepted-task close observes that concrete failure.

Responder catches only StreamClosedError as expected abandonment. Other ordinary header/data/TLS-write errors tag the responder-owned record and store the original exception on its original Http2Origin.

Deferred responder does not raise into an unrelated triggering handler. collect_closed transfers and clears retained errors once before collecting actual child/writer results; existing capture cleanup propagates them.
Successful headers/data/write ordering and existing inbound ProtocolError handling are exact. No retry, buffering, protocol fallback or report schema change.
open_scope: Broad ConnectionError and SSLError handling and TLS.read SSLError-to-empty behavior are unchanged; no actual category proof from these four controls.
Deferred H2/H3 cross-connection callback attribution is source design only, not executed by the current four controls. Late callback/beyond-budget behavior remains bounded and unproven.
BaseException response paths and simultaneous/multiple cleanup combinations are not newly measured.
Root must add qualified CHANGELOG/evidence and run original four, composed controls/full capture, pinned Ruff and docs before acceptance; no full A191 closure.
